eligibility.rule: US_DOMESTIC_FILER_AT_AS_OF: the latest periodic report the issuer filed on or before as_of is a 10-K/10-Q. Foreign private issuers at as_of (20-F/40-F) are excluded from the US Market-Cap Top 500 (user decision 2026-09-25; their US lines are mostly ADRs whose ratio is not in SEC data). Issuers with no SEC filing by as_of did not exist as registrants then and are excluded. Basis: SEC submissions 'recent' + older filing pages, filingDate <= as_of (PIT; today's forms are not applied backward). An issuer with neither a periodic report nor a traded price by as_of was not listed then (excluded).

audit.note: Diagnostic only. Explicit listings input is not proof of historical US-listing completeness.

universe_completeness_gate.benchmark_source: World Federation of Exchanges (WFE), "Market Statistics - February 2025" (WFE Focus), Total Dec'24 column
universe_completeness_gate.note: Sizes the universe only; identity completeness (candidate_pool_complete) is never set True by this gate. An independent path to Official promotion -- see build_top500_sufficiency_gate for the other.

references.name: SP500_PIT_RECONSTRUCTION
references.source: Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' current snapshot + dated changes table (fetched 2026-09-25)

top500_sufficiency_gate.note: Does not require universe completeness. Passes only when >=1 independently sourced, dated (PIT) large-cap reference has every member present, rankable, and inside the computed top 500 -- i.e. positive evidence no plausible missed company changes the top 500.

base_gate.note: Fail-closed. >=500 ranked alone never proves Official Top-500 completeness.

promotion_gate_v2.note: Fail-closed. Requires base numeric/eligibility checks AND (universe completeness OR top-500 sufficiency).

note: Fail-closed chain. S&P 500 is a missing-large-cap detector only and cannot by itself pass Sufficiency.
